title: With a $4.1 Million Agreement, Saint Louis University's Geospatial Center Will Train Federal Workforce
summary_en: Saint Louis University's Geospatial Center has been awarded a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) from the federal government's GEOINT Learning Through Academic Program (GLAP) to develop training for the geospatial sciences.
